|translation='''Title:''' Planet Defender Ion Cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at an exterior location that has a Rebel Base. Cannot be moved. During a battle at the system card of the same planet, spend 2 Force to fire at a capital ship. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 exceeds armor, all of the target’s weapons are lost, and power and hyperspeed become 0.

'''Lore:'''
KDY v-150 surface-to-space heavy ion cannon. It is the strongest of the Rebellion’s surface artillery weapons. Because few exist, it can be deployed only at tactically important facilities.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 固定兵器.
